propositions: BindingStore must be refactored into a private BindingRepository unit-of-work while maintaining the unchanged public facade and preserving all existing load/save byte contracts.

The repository must handle file paths, JSON tempfiles, per-file os.replace operations, and rotation-before-live ordering without introducing multi-file atomicity or altering existing exception semantics.
Legacy records with unknown fields must load and round-trip with exact byte preservation and no eager rewrite, verified by direct-repository and facade test suites.

Failure injection tests must verify that named fault cuts (tempfile, rotation replace, retired replace, live replace, alert write) produce documented file combinations and identical raise/swallow/alert behavior as the original implementation.
Tickets publication in reconcile_helpers.py must remain an external five-file allowlisted seam with no new staging or per-checkpoint commits.
An ADR must document repository ownership, ordered partial-state behavior, selective publication, no-journal/no-format-migration decision, and recovery boundary distinctions.
